h1: Custom 6 oz Barware for Events & Promotions
metaDescription: Shop custom 6 oz barware for your next event. Bulk pricing and fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Six-ounce barware hits a sweet spot between a standard shot and a double, making it ideal for serving spirits, shooters, or dessert drinks at promotional events and corporate gatherings. Choose from rocks glasses, shot glasses, or mini tumblers in this versatile size, and imprint your logo with screen printing, etching, or full-wrap digital decoration. Custom 6 oz barware gives attendees a practical keepsake that stands out on any bar cart or office breakroom shelf.
heroAltText: Custom 6 oz barware featuring a clear rocks glass with a corporate logo printed in white
